review_evidence: README identifies a verified computation of the Mandelbrot Bottcher series, built on formal complex dynamics, interval arithmetic, and power-series libraries.
Bottcher/Pray.lean proves analytic and derivative facts for cascade/descent, approximation theorems for power-series computations, and correctness of a Newton solver for the Bottcher-series function.
These files contain substantive complex-analysis and verified-numerics definitions and proofs, so the formal source should remain searchable.
summary: Retain bottcher as verified complex-dynamics and power-series computation with analytic and Newton-correctness proofs.
